title: Meaisin Cliste - Celtic AI Tools
voiceover_lines: Welcome to Meaisin Cliste, Space 2 of 4. The element is Aer, the language-carrier, with Uisce for the water theme.
Three themes. The first is Focloir na Se Naisiun - a 6-nation Celtic cognate dictionary. Thirty hand-picked cognates, all grounded in the same proto-Celtic roots.
The second theme is Scoil ar an Learscail - school on the map. Twenty-six counties, sixteen hundred and twenty-nine schools, coloured by the Pobal HP Deprivation Index 2022.
The third theme is Curaclam Trasteorann - cross-border curriculum. The BAML chain compares how a topic is taught across five Celtic-nation curricula.
